en.s: The Battle of Kemej (Hungarian: kemeji csata) was an internal conflict between Solomon, King of Hungary and his cousin Duke Géza, took place on 26 February 1074 near Kemej in present-day Heves County. As a result of a betrayal, Géza was defeated, but he managed to flee from the advancing and overwhelming royal army.

zh.s: 凯梅伊战役（匈牙利语：kemeji csata）于1074年2月26日在今天匈牙利赫维什州的凯梅伊附近发生，是匈牙利国王所罗门与其堂弟盖佐公爵之间的内战。盖佐遭到背叛后战败，但成功逃离追击他的王室大军。

en.s: The Battle of Benevento was a major medieval battle fought on 26 February 1266, near Benevento in present-day Southern Italy, between the forces of Charles I of Anjou and those of King Manfred of Sicily. Manfred's defeat and death resulted in Charles' conquest of the Kingdom of Sicily, effectively ending the rule of the Hohenstaufen dynasty in the Italian Peninsula and marking the rise of the royal Capetian House of Anjou. The engagement was part of the conflict which pitted Guelphs against Ghibellines.

zh.s: 1266年2月26日，安茹的查理一世与西西里国王曼弗雷德的军队，在今意大利南部贝内文托附近交战。曼弗雷德战败身亡，查理由此征服西西里王国，实际上终结霍亨斯陶芬王朝在意大利半岛的统治，标志着卡佩王朝安茹支系兴起。这场中世纪重要战役，属于归尔甫派与吉伯林派之间的冲突。

en.t: Thado Minbya founds the city of Ava
en.s: On February 26, 1365, Thado Minbya formally founded Ava, now Inwa in Myanmar, on an artificial island formed with canals and the surrounding rivers. The city became the capital of his kingdom.

zh.s: 1365年2月26日，德多明帕正式建立阿瓦城，即今缅甸因瓦。城市坐落在由运河与周边河流围成的人工岛上，后来成为其王国的都城。

en.s: Battle of Vilémov was a military clash between the Bohemian army under the command of the Bohemian King George of Poděbrady and the Hungarian army as part of the Crusade campaign led by the Hungarian King Matthias Corvinus within the framework of the Bohemian-Hungarian Wars. It took place on 26 February 1469, in the vicinity of the village of Vilémov and ended with the encirclement of Corvinus' army in the valley of the river Doubrava, after which the two monarchs met and talked in Úhrov averting a direct clash of troops.

zh.s: 1469年2月26日，波希米亚国王波杰布拉德的伊日率军，与匈牙利国王马加什·科尔维努斯发动十字军行动的部队，在维莱莫夫村附近对峙，属于波希米亚—匈牙利战争。科尔维努斯的军队被包围在杜布拉瓦河谷，随后两位君主在乌赫罗夫会谈，避免了两军直接交锋。

en.s: The Battle of Hisar Firoza took place in Hisar, in the state of Haryana, India between Zahir-ud-din Muhammad Babur and Hamid Khan on 26 February 1526. Babur with his son Humayun clashed against the Afghans under the command of Hamid Khan. It was the first battle of Humayun and he was only eighteen years old back then. Humayun had a significant victory against Hamid Khan in the battle of Hisar Firoza.

zh.s: 1526年2月26日，查希尔丁·穆罕默德·巴布尔与哈米德汗，在今印度哈里亚纳邦希萨尔交战。巴布尔与儿子胡马雍迎战哈米德汗指挥的阿富汗部队。这是年仅18岁的胡马雍首次参战，他在希萨尔菲罗扎战役中取得重大胜利。

en.s: The Aden revolt of 1548 was a rebellion against Ottoman rule in Yemen, that was suppressed after Ottoman forces under Piri Reis arrived on 26 February 1548.

zh.s: 1548年，也门亚丁发生反抗奥斯曼统治的起义。皮里·雷斯率奥斯曼部队于2月26日抵达后，起义被镇压。

en.t: Janszoon’s expedition makes a recorded European landing in Australia
en.s: On February 26, 1606, Willem Janszoon’s Duyfken expedition landed near the present-day Pennefather River on Cape York Peninsula, Australia. It is the first recorded European landing on the Australian continent.

zh.t: 扬松的探险队在澳大利亚登陆
zh.s: 1606年2月26日，威廉·扬松率“杜伊夫肯”号探险队在今澳大利亚约克角半岛彭尼法瑟河附近登陆。这是有记录以来欧洲人首次在澳大利亚大陆登陆。

en.t: Russian and Kalmyk forces recapture Terki
en.s: On February 26, 1708, Russian and Kalmyk forces led by Fyodor Apraksin and Ayuka Khan recaptured Terki, in present-day Russia, from North Caucasian rebels.

zh.t: 俄罗斯与卡尔梅克军队夺回捷尔基
zh.s: 1708年2月26日，费奥多尔·阿普拉克辛与阿玉奇汗率领俄罗斯和卡尔梅克军队，从北高加索叛军手中夺回今俄罗斯境内的捷尔基。

en.s: On February 26, 1760, French troops under François Thurot re-embarked and left Carrickfergus, in present-day Northern Ireland, United Kingdom, after occupying the town for several days. Their initial capture of the town had taken place earlier.

zh.t: 法军撤离卡里克弗格斯
zh.s: 1760年2月26日，弗朗索瓦·蒂罗率领的法军在占领卡里克弗格斯数日后登船离去，地点位于今英国北爱尔兰。法军攻占该城发生在此前，并非当天。

en.t: British troops and colonists reach a peaceful compromise at Salem
en.s: On February 26, 1775, British troops sent to seize military stores at Salem, in present-day Massachusetts, United States, confronted local colonists. The standoff ended through a compromise, without shots being fired.

zh.t: 英军与塞勒姆殖民地居民通过妥协结束对峙
zh.s: 1775年2月26日，英军奉命前往今美国马萨诸塞州塞勒姆收缴军需物资，与当地殖民地居民对峙。双方最终达成妥协，没有开枪。

en.t: A fire destroys the first Christiansborg Palace
en.s: On February 26, 1794, a fire broke out at Christiansborg Palace in Copenhagen, Denmark, after a stove overheated near the Great Hall. Most of the first palace was destroyed.

zh.t: 克里斯蒂安堡宫遭大火焚毁
zh.s: 1794年2月26日，丹麦哥本哈根的克里斯蒂安堡宫因大厅附近火炉过热发生火灾，第一代宫殿的大部分建筑被毁。

en.t: Norway’s parliamentary election period reaches its final day
en.s: On February 26, 1818, the stated election period for Norway’s 1817 parliamentary election reached its final day. Voting had begun in August 1817. Those elected served without formal political party affiliations.

zh.t: 挪威1817年议会选举进入最后一天
zh.s: 1818年2月26日，资料所载的挪威1817年议会选举投票期进入最后一天。投票自1817年8月开始，当选议员当时均无正式政党归属。

en.s: The battle of Colonia del Sacramento (or Colônia do Sacramento) consisted of a series of failed attempts made by admiral William Brown of capturing the town of Colonia del Sacramento, which was under Brazilian control and being sieged on land by insurgent Uruguayan forces, in the context of the Cisplatine War between the Empire of Brazil and the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata. The confrontations began in the morning of 26 February 1826 and ended on 14 March 1826.

zh.t: 科洛尼亚德尔萨克拉门托战役（1826年）
zh.s: 科洛尼亚德尔萨克拉门托战役（又称Colônia do Sacramento战役）由一系列未能攻下科洛尼亚德尔萨克拉门托的行动组成。当时该镇由巴西控制，陆上正遭乌拉圭起义军围攻。战役发生在巴西帝国与拉普拉塔联合省之间的西斯普拉蒂纳战争期间。威廉·布朗海军上将于1826年2月26日开始进攻，交战持续至同年3月14日。

en.s: On February 26, 1836, Spain held a general election for all 149 seats in its Congress of Deputies.

zh.s: 1836年2月26日，西班牙举行大选，选出众议院全部149个议席。

en.s: The Battle of the Bogue (Chinese: 虎門之戰) was fought between British and Chinese forces in the Pearl River Delta, Guangdong province, China, on 23–26 February 1841 during the First Opium War. The British launched an amphibious attack at the Humen strait (Bogue), capturing the forts on the islands of Anunghoy and North Wangtong. This allowed the fleet to proceed further up the Pearl River towards the city of Canton (Guangzhou), which they captured the following month.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 虎门之战于1841年2月23日至26日在中国广东珠江三角洲发生，是第一次鸦片战争期间英中两军之间的一场战斗。英军发动两栖进攻，攻占了位于安南海和北王通岛的炮台，从而得以继续沿珠江向广州推进。英军于次月攻占广州。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle of Gdow (Polish language: Bitwa pod Gdowem) took place on February 26, 1846 near Gdow, Free City of Krakow. It was the only battle of the Krakow Uprising: a 380-strong rebel unit commanded by Jakub Suchorzewski was defeated by a 480-strong Austrian Army detachment under Ludwig von Benedek. The Austrians were supported by some 500 local peasants (see Galician slaughter). Rebel losses were estimated at 154 killed in action, while Austrian losses were negligible. After the Krakow Uprising had begun, an Austrian detachment under Colonel Ludwig von Benedek left Tarnów, heading towards Krakow.

zh.s: 1846年2月26日，克拉科夫自由市格杜夫附近发生战斗，这是克拉科夫起义中唯一的一场战役。雅库布·苏霍热夫斯基率领的380名起义者，被路德维希·冯·贝内德克指挥的480名奥地利士兵击败。奥军还得到约500名当地农民支持，这与加利西亚农民屠杀事件有关。起义者估计有154人阵亡，奥军损失微乎其微。起义开始后，贝内德克上校率这支部队从塔尔努夫出发，向克拉科夫行进。

en.t: Beach’s pneumatic railway opens in New York
en.s: On February 26, 1870, Alfred Ely Beach’s experimental pneumatic railway opened to the public in New York City, United States. The short underground line demonstrated an air-powered transit system.

zh.t: 比奇气动铁路在纽约开放
zh.s: 1870年2月26日，阿尔弗雷德·伊利·比奇的实验性气动铁路在美国纽约向公众开放。这条短途地下线路用来展示依靠空气压力驱动的交通系统。

en.s: The Japan–Korea Treaty of 1876 (also known as the Japan–Korea Treaty of Amity in Japan and the Treaty of Ganghwa Island in Korea) was made between representatives of the Empire of Japan and the Kingdom of Joseon in 1876. Negotiations were concluded on February 26, 1876. In Korea, Heungseon Daewongun, who instituted a policy of increased isolationism against the European powers, was forced into retirement by his son King Gojong and Gojong's wife, Empress Myeongseong.

zh.s: 1876年日朝条约又称日本的《日朝修好条规》或韩国的《江华岛条约》，由日本帝国和朝鲜王国的代表于1876年签订。双方于1876年2月26日结束谈判。在朝鲜，推行对欧洲列强更加孤立政策的兴宣大院君被其子高宗和高宗之妻明成皇后迫使退位。

en.t: Norway’s parliamentary election period reaches its final day
en.s: On February 26, 1877, the stated election period for Norway’s 1876 parliamentary election reached its final day. Voting had begun in June 1876, before formal political parties were established in the country.

zh.t: 挪威1876年议会选举进入最后一天
zh.s: 1877年2月26日，资料所载的挪威1876年议会选举投票期进入最后一天。投票自1876年6月开始，当时挪威尚未建立正式政党。

en.s: The 1887 New South Wales colonial election was held between 4 February and 26 February 1887. This election was for all of the 124 seats in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly and it was conducted in 37 single-member constituencies, 23 2-member constituencies, seven 3-member constituencies and five 4-member constituencies, all with a first past the post system.

zh.s: 1887年新南威尔士殖民地选举于1887年2月4日至26日举行，选出立法议会全部124个席位。选举分布在37个单议席选区、23个双议席选区、7个三议席选区和5个四议席选区进行，均采用相对多数制。

en.s: The 1901 Stretford by-election was held on 26 February 1901 after the death of the incumbent Conservative MP, Sir John William Maclure. It was retained by the Conservative candidate Charles Cripps.

zh.s: 1901年2月26日，英国斯特雷特福德选区举行补选，填补保守党议员约翰·威廉·麦克卢尔爵士去世留下的空缺。保守党候选人查尔斯·克里普斯当选，保住该席。

en.s: The Brigg by-election of 1907 was held on 26 February 1907. The by-election was held due to the resignation of the incumbent Liberal MP, Harold James Reckitt. It was won by the Conservative candidate Berkeley Sheffield.

zh.s: 1907年2月26日，英国布里格选区举行补选，原因是自由党议员哈罗德·詹姆斯·雷基特辞职。保守党候选人伯克利·谢菲尔德当选。

en.s: The 1912 Glasgow St Rollox by-election was a Parliamentary by-election held on 26 February 1912. The constituency returned one Member of Parliament (MP) to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, elected by the first past the post voting system.

zh.t: 1912年格拉斯哥圣罗洛克斯选区补选
zh.s: 1912年2月26日，格拉斯哥圣罗洛克斯选区举行议会补选。该选区采用得票最多者当选的方式，选出一名英国下议院议员。

en.s: The Action of Agagia (also Agagiya, Aqqaqia or Aqaqia) took place east of Sidi Barrani in Egypt on 26 February 1916, during the Senussi Campaign between German and Ottoman-instigated Senussi forces and the British army in Egypt. On 11 December 1915, a British column had been attacked at Duwwar Hussein along the Matruh–Sollum track.

zh.s: 阿加吉亚战役又称阿加吉亚、阿卡基亚或阿卡基亚战役，于1916年2月26日在埃及西迪巴拉尼以东发生，是塞努西战役的一部分。交战双方是受德国和奥斯曼帝国煽动的塞努西武装与驻埃及英军。此前，1915年12月11日，一支英军纵队曾在马特鲁至索卢姆道路上的杜瓦尔侯赛因遭到袭击。

en.s: The Happy Valley Racecourse fire (Chinese: 跑馬地馬場大火) took place on 26 February 1918 in the Happy Valley Racecourse located at Happy Valley, British Hong Kong. The catastrophe caused the loss of 670 lives, making it the third deadliest fire in the history of Hong Kong, and one of the deadliest incidents in sporting history. Mainland Chinese sources have often included it among the top ten fires in 20th-century China.

zh.s: 1918年2月26日，香港跑马地马场发生大火，造成670人死亡。这是香港历史上死亡人数第三多的火灾，也是体育赛事史上伤亡最惨重的事故之一。中国大陆资料常将其列为20世纪中国十大火灾之一。

en.s: The Liverpool West Derby by-election, 1919 was a parliamentary by-election held on 26 February 1919 for the British House of Commons constituency of Liverpool West Derby, in the County Palatine of Lancashire.

zh.s: 1919年2月26日，英国下议院位于兰开夏行宫伯爵领的利物浦西德比选区举行议会补选。

en.s: The Battle of Zalău was a tactical-level military engagement that took place from February 23rd to 26th, 1919, in the area of the town of Zalău in Szilágy County (now Sălaj County). The conflict involved Hungarian troops from the Székely Division attacking Romanians from the 13th Infantry Brigade. This battle was part of the broader military operations defending the Great Union during the Romanian Army's efforts to occupy the demarcation line in Transylvania during the Hungarian–Romanian War.

zh.s: 扎勒乌战役是一次战术级军事交战，于1919年2月23日至26日在锡拉吉县（今瑟拉日县）扎勒乌镇一带发生。战斗中，塞凯伊师的匈牙利军队进攻罗马尼亚第13步兵旅。该战役是匈牙利—罗马尼亚战争期间的一系列军事行动的一部分；罗马尼亚军队当时试图占领特兰西瓦尼亚的分界线，以保卫大联合。

en.t: Wilson signs the law creating Grand Canyon National Park
en.s: On February 26, 1919, US president Woodrow Wilson signed the law establishing Grand Canyon National Park in Arizona, United States. The canyon had previously been designated a national monument.

zh.t: 威尔逊签署设立大峡谷国家公园的法律
zh.s: 1919年2月26日，美国总统伍德罗·威尔逊签署法律，在美国亚利桑那州设立大峡谷国家公园。在此之前，大峡谷已被列为国家纪念地。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Dalley on 26 February 1927. This was triggered by the resignation of Labor MP William Mahony. The by-election was won by former Queensland Premier Ted Theodore, the Labor candidate. After the by-election there was some suggestion that Theodore had bribed Mahony to resign so that he might enter Parliament.

zh.s: 澳大利亚众议院达利选区于1927年2月26日举行补选，起因是工党议员威廉·马奥尼辞职。工党候选人、前昆士兰州州长特德·西奥多获胜。补选后有人指称，西奥多曾贿赂马奥尼辞职，以便自己进入议会。

en.t: A decree authorizes the Luftwaffe as a separate armed service
en.s: On February 26, 1935, Adolf Hitler, Hermann Göring and Werner von Blomberg signed a decree establishing the Luftwaffe as a separate branch of Germany’s armed forces. The decree took effect on March 1, distinct from the later public announcement.

zh.t: 德国签署设立独立空军的法令
zh.s: 1935年2月26日，阿道夫·希特勒、赫尔曼·戈林和维尔纳·冯·勃洛姆堡签署法令，将空军设为德国武装力量的独立军种。法令于3月1日生效，与后来对外公布的时间不同。

en.t: In the February 26 Incident, young nationalist Japanese military officers assassinate multiple cabinet statesmen and start a rebellion in downtown Tokyo, which is ended 3 days later
en.s: The February 26 incident (二・二六事件, Ni Ni-Roku Jiken), also known as the 2–26 incident, was an attempted coup d'état in the Empire of Japan on 26 February 1936. It was organized by a group of young Imperial Japanese Army (IJA) officers with the goal of purging the government and military leadership of their factional rivals and ideological opponents.

zh.s: 二二六事件（日本语：二・二六事件，Ni Ni-Roku Jiken）又称“2·26事件”，是日本帝国于1936年2月26日发生的一场未遂政变。年轻的日本陆军军官组织了这次政变，目的是清除与他们派系敌对、政见相左的政府和军方领导人。军官在东京市中心刺杀多名内阁要员并发动叛乱，三天后叛乱被平定。

en.s: The Rogachev–Zhlobin offensive was a Soviet-led military offensive that took place from 21 to 26 February 1944 within the Eastern Front of World War II. Soviet forces aimed to advance through Rogachev and defeat the German 9th Army of Army Group Centre, which culminated with the movements of other units in preparation of Operation Bagration.

zh.s: 罗加乔夫—日洛宾攻势是第二次世界大战东线战场的一次苏军攻势，于1944年2月21日至26日进行。苏军计划经罗加乔夫推进，击败中央集团军群的德国第九军团，为其他部队调动和巴格拉季昂行动做准备。

en.s: The Battle of Corregidor (Filipino: Labanan para sa Corregidor), which occurred from 16 to 26 February 1945, pitted American forces against the defending Japanese garrison on the island fortress. The Japanese had captured the bastion from the United States Army Forces in the Far East during their 1942 invasion.

en.t: US sailors inspect a Soviet trawler after Atlantic cable breaks
en.s: On February 26, 1959, sailors from USS Roy O. Hale boarded the Soviet vessel Novorossiysk in international waters off Newfoundland to investigate breaks in undersea telecommunications cables. The inspection did not establish that the vessel had caused the damage.

zh.t: 美军登上苏联拖网渔船调查海底电缆断裂

en.s: The Battle of Al Busayyah was a tank battle fought just in the pre-dawn darkness on February 26, 1991, during the Persian Gulf War, between armored forces of the United States Army and those of the Iraqi Army. The battle is named after the Iraqi town of Al Busayyah, which sat at a critical crossroads and was an Iraqi Army stronghold. The town consisted of forty to fifty buildings, most located along one main north-south road. It was defended by a battalion-sized Iraqi infantry unit reinforced by T-55 tanks, armored personnel carriers, and elements of an Iraqi commando battalion.

Khojaly was an Azerbaijani-populated town of some 6,300 people in the Nagorno-Karabakh Autonomous Oblast of Azerbaijan SSR, also housing the region's only airport in 1992.

en.s: The elections for City and Village Councils of Iran were held on 26 February 1999, for the first time in the history of Iran to elect some 200,000 seats. These elections saw great levels of public participation and civic engagement and still tend to be viewed as an "historic moment" and important opportunity for citizens to play an active part in the management of their municipalities at a local level. In many large cities, especially Tehran and Isfahan, candidates from 2nd of Khordad movement won the elections. Independents were elected in most rural areas, reflecting concern for local issues which competed with the wider national debate over an emerging “civil society.”

en.s: On 26 February 2013, a hot air balloon crashed near Luxor, Egypt, killing 19 out of the 21 people on board. It was the deadliest ballooning accident in history and the deadliest aerostat disaster since the Hindenburg disaster in 1937, which killed 36 people.

en.t: 2018 National Party of Australia leadership election

en.s: The 2023 EFL Cup final was the final of the 2022–23 EFL Cup. It was played between Manchester United and Newcastle United at Wembley Stadium in London on 26 February 2023. This was Newcastle's first final since the 1999 FA Cup final, in which Manchester United defeated them 2–0. Newcastle were aiming to end one of the longest trophy droughts in English football, with their last major honour being the 1968–69 Inter-Cities Fairs Cup.

zh.s: 2022—23赛季英格兰联赛杯决赛于2023年2月26日在伦敦温布利球场举行，由曼联对阵纽卡斯尔联。这是纽卡斯尔自1999年足总杯决赛以来首次进入决赛，当年他们以0比2输给曼联。纽卡斯尔希望结束英格兰足坛持续最久的冠军荒之一，球队上一次重要冠军是1968—69赛季国际城市博览会杯。

en.s: The 2023 Democratic Party leadership election was a primary election that was held in Italy in February 2023 to elect the National Assembly and secretary of the Italian Democratic Party (PD). It consisted of a closed primary election among party members held from 9 to 19 February, and an open primary election held on 26 February.

en.s: The Machulishchy air base attack occurred on February 26, 2023, at the Machulishchy military airfield, around 12 km (7.5 mi) from Minsk, a Russian A-50 early warning military aircraft was damaged as a result of explosions. BYPOL claimed responsibility for the drone attack. Belarusian president Alexander Lukashenko acknowledged the attack only a week later, stating that the damage to the aircraft was minor.

zh.s: 2023年2月26日，马丘利希军事机场遭到袭击，地点距明斯克约12公里（7.5英里）。爆炸导致一架俄罗斯A-50预警机受损。BYPOL声称对无人机袭击负责。白俄罗斯总统亚历山大·卢卡申科一周后才承认发生袭击，并称飞机受损轻微。

en.s: The 73rd annual Berlin International Film Festival, usually called the Berlinale (German pronunciation: [bɛʁliˈnaːlə] ), took place from 16 to 26 February 2023. It was the first completely in-person Berlinale since the 70th in 2020. The festival added a new competition section for television series. The festival opened with American filmmaker and novelist Rebecca Miller's drama film She Came to Me.
